notes: WP-C (docs/archive/engine/fidelity/12-WPC-charts.md §8.1): spellings the chart model now reads one way,
and the specs a model writes. 8 text elements: the h1 plus one caption per chart, each its own
absolutely positioned block. 7 chart elements, one authored data-chart each.
A, B, C: probe p05's A-C verbatim — the same bridge with its totals given as indices, as
series.types and as per-point booleans. All three must emit the same bars (int(True) was 1).
A has no plotArea, so its connectors pin chart_model.layout's default rect.
E: a two-series stacked waterfall; no bar crosses zero, so Internal is the bottom colour in every
bar and the legend lists the two authored series only (c:legendEntry deletes the rest).
G: the Sonnet waterfall of prj_844d2914db (sld_124e333385 v001), copied verbatim: a list of
pointColors (WP3a raised on it and left a half-built chart), a hidden value axis, its own plotArea.
H: probe p11-A's bridge near 3,400 (#,##0), whose connectors PowerPoint misplaced (F3f).
I: a clustered column with a reference line at exactly the third bar's value (61), for the
reference-line measurement; valueAxis min/max are given because a reference line needs a pinned
value axis to be placed at all (a non-waterfall keeps PowerPoint's automatic axis otherwise).
Every spec lints without errors; G's list of pointColors is a chart-advisory warning.

gateMaxPx2 860 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 716 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
